shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin and Ethereum prices surged over 5%, leading a broader altcoin rally and boosting the total crypto market cap.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index registers "Greed" at 60, reflecting positive investor sentiment.
The CLARITY Act, a US crypto regulatory bill, stalled in the U.S. Senate, leaving regulatory clarity uncertain.
Falling bond yields and oil prices post-Fed rate hike eased inflation worries, boosting risk assets including crypto.
Ongoing Middle East tensions and US sanctions on an Iranian crypto exchange pose geopolitical risks.
